items.title: Bind the explicit high-risk 3x2 predicate to runtime process facts
items.context: gap_analyze reports two high uncovered requirements from lattice-strengthening-roadmap-execution-plan.md where requires3x2 depends on explicitlyConfiguredHighRiskPolicyRequires3x2. Existing review assurance floor logic enforces high-risk 3x2 or degraded fallback, but the precise predicate name is not bound into the process-fact surface consumed by DONE/gap analysis.
relatedDocs: docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-strengthening-roadmap-execution-plan.md#M8. Host Identity, Review-Run, And 3x2 Quorum Strengthening

happy.desc: A story with a valid explicit high-risk policy fact requires 3x2 even when first-review countable problems are below threshold, and full 3x2 host verdicts satisfy the local gate.

edge.desc: A story without the explicit policy fact still does not require 3x2 merely because a decision doc, lifecycle path, or prose mentions high-risk classes.

adversarial.desc: The explicit policy branch and fallback output must keep authorityDone/fullAuthorityDone/productionDone false and must not report degraded 3x1 as full 3x2.

items.userSees: `review_escalation_status --storyId=<story> --json` includes an explicit high-risk policy trigger when a valid structured policy fact exists, and still shows authorityDone=false/fullAuthorityDone=false/productionDone=false.

items.title: Add contract and convergence evidence for the high-risk policy binding
items.context: The fix must be mechanically verified: process fact contract should protect the explicit predicate binding and gap_analyze/convergence_check should no longer report the two high-priority uncovered requirements.

happy.desc: `gap_analyze` no longer reports the two high-priority uncovered requirements for explicitlyConfiguredHighRiskPolicyRequires3x2.
`scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs` protects the explicit high-risk policy predicate binding in the L4 runtime process facts.

edge.desc: `convergence_check` reports No high-priority gaps passed while still preserving unfinished-story checks separately.

adversarial.desc: Regression tests fail if the explicit predicate token disappears from evaluator, registry, or smoke coverage while gap_analyze still appears healthy.

items.userSees: `gap_analyze` reports `Gaps: 0 high / 0 medium`, and `convergence_check` shows `No high-priority gaps` as passed while unfinished stories remain a separate check.

auditLog.reason: Start implementing explicit high-risk policy fact branch
